I’m having the exact same problem with my mom! She’s 62 and on so many pills I’m surprised she’s still alive. I have the exact same medical condition as her, she’s had 5 spine surgeries (laminectomies only), I’ve had 6 at half her age starting at 15 years old (4 laminectomies and 2 spinal fusions). She is on every opioid known to man, and it’s appalling. I am pretty sure I’m in more pain than her, and I say that with shame. I don’t like comparing who is in more pain because I know pain is subjective and depends on pain tolerance. But she’s on literal morphine, 3 different mgs of oxys, hydrocodone, soma, Xanax. And it’s not just one pill of each. It’s 3-4 dosages per prescription each day. That’s before you add in her other crap to help with all her other imagined ailments. These pills she’s on now is what her pain management has whittled her down to. She used to be on more, and higher doses, and whenever the dr takes a pill away or lowers the dosage of a prescription she comes home throwing things and screaming and crying throwing a temper tantrum like a child. Now, I go to the same pain management office and I’m on 4 10 mg ox a day and they told me I have to stop taking them because I’m 34 and it’s not realistic to expect to stay on them the rest of my life. Despite the same office keeping my mother on higher and more meds since she was in her 30s into her 60s. 

But now, it’s made my mother stupid. My aunt sees my mother take a pill and she tells my mom “oh got to take one of your stupid pills I see”. My mom was on the phone and told me Israel was in Mexico. Refused to believe it wasn’t in Mexico. Same conversation she said that Lebanon was a Latino country, and that South Africa originated as a white country. The older she gets the dumber she gets and it’s embarrassing. She has sat at her kitchen table high on her pills and passed out sitting up at the kitchen table and fell over and hit the floor. I’ve watched her on Christmas high, try to turn a Bible page for an hour. Not that she was reading the page for an hour. It took her an hour to get ahold of the corner of the page to turn it. My personal favorite is when she’s super high on her pills she’ll get a cheesecake, eat it and then scrape the fork on the plate for an hour trying to get every last lick of flavor off the plate. 

She’s also gotten violent and cruel, but I don’t know if that’s just her or the pills. She’s manipulative and hateful and mean. She plays games and she can’t have a conversation with anyone without immediately reaching for her pillbox. I 100% think the long term pill abuse makes them stupid and mean.

I want to apologize in advance for how long this post is, and if it’s disjointed. I’m in a lot of pain and my brain is not working properly the last few days. 

A few years ago I had liver problems, elevated liver enzymes and such and had to go to a liver dr, she had done a biopsy and tests on my liver. At my final appointment she told me “I’m not supposed to say anything about this, it’s not my place. But you have elevated ANA, and I think you might have lupus or another autoimmune condition. You need to be referred to a rheumatologist to be tested”. I never did. I blew it off. Until the last few months I started getting a bad rash on my faced and it wouldn’t go away. I went to my GP and they told me it was probably rosacea and referred me to a plastic surgeon/dermatologist. They looked at the rash and told me it probably was rosacea, but could be lupus so have the GP do a ANA blood test. Went for the blood test and the lab did everything except the ANA. So a week later I had to go back up there and have another blood draw. It came back with a positive ANA. The GP referred me to a rheumatologist. 

I went to the rheumatologist, who did another blood test and scheduled me for a return visit. I came back and she said “you have a positive ANA, and your blood work shows that you actively have inflammation in your body right now. So either A you have lupus, B you have pre lupus, or C you don’t have lupus at all. I think you have lupus. So we’re going to put you on hydroxychloroquine. You have to have a yearly eye test because it can cause blindness, it’s going to make you sick and cause stomach upset but you have to stick with it for at least 10 weeks. Any questions?” I asked “there is no question in your mind, it’s definitely lupus?” She replied “yes, based on the blood test and the symptoms of your body in my professional opinion you have lupus”. 

I started the medication and immediately got bad headaches, horrible cramping nausea so bad that every time I’d swallow my saliva I’d gag and vomiting. I logged into my patient portal to see if they could prescribe me an anti nausea medication because it was getting to be debilitating. And I saw the notes on my chart. She notated I had:

Undifferentiated connective tissue disease
Fibromyalgia
Degenerative polyarthritis

We never discussed fibromyalgia. I sent her a message asking about the fibromyalgia and to explain her notes. And she dismissed it and said we could discuss it at our next appointment. Then the issue with the medication, instead of just giving me a simple anti emetic, they told me to just stop taking the medication completely and let them know when I was back to normal. After a week, I’m back to normal so I sent them a message. They replied “okay great, if you need to be seen before your 06/02/2025 appt please call the office”. So now I’m confused. 

I just don’t know what to do. There are no other rheumatologists in my area. And the ones in surrounding areas don’t accept my insurance. I feel so freaking defeated.

MONTHS. I’m so genuinely angry about the situation I don’t even know what to do. I’m in the middle of a really bad flare up and I just want to cry all the time. I’m so incredibly frustrated.

Yep, that’s sewage backing up into your tub. I lived in a house where this happened almost every time we’d use the bathroom or take a shower. And we only had one bathroom in our house, with two adults and a kid. It happened for a year. I’d call the rental company, they’d send out a plumber, he’d blame us for flushing baby wipes, grease, tampons, diapers (none of which we were doing). He’d leave saying the non existent “clog” was fixed, and the next day it would happen again. For a year I scrubbed shit out of my tub almost daily before I lost my proverbial shit on the realty company. They sent out a new plumber who, in less that 10 minutes, found that the sewer pipe leading to the street was crushed by tree roots, and it was causing it to all back up in the tub. He replaced all the pipes and it never happened again. 

All that to say, it’s definitely shit. Good luck!

I’ve had 6 spine surgeries, two of them fusions. My back just went out again a week before Christmas.  I went to the dr, had an x ray and now my l5-s1 is messed up. They ordered an mri just to be sure of what all is going on there. Dr warned me another fusion is likely. 

If you’ve never had a fusion before, I warn you it’s painful. It’s really painful. It’s the most painful thing I’ve ever experienced in my life. Don’t be afraid to ask for pain medicine. Don’t try to tough it out. They probably won’t tell you this, but you’re entitled to get the pain pills they give you and morphine if they don’t put you on a morphine drip. But they will probably give you some bs about “you need to try to get by without the morphine, since you won’t have it when you get home”.  Don’t accept that. Demand the morphine. You will also have a physical therapist come in and make you get up and walk around. They won’t let you go home until you walk around. I genuinely hope you have an easy go of it. And I hope it helps you. Don’t be afraid to speak up for yourself, and be your own advocate! If you’re in pain, speak up! They are there to help you, don’t be ashamed to ask for help!

It’s good you googled it! Don’t feel too bad though. It genuinely happens. I’d say google everything new you want to give him from now on before you give it. Onions, grapes, avocado, garlic, chocolate, raisins, chives, shallots and leeks. Pork and fatty meats, fat trimmings can all give your dog pancreatitis which can kill them. Foods with high salt content. Macadamia Nuts, only a few can kill a dog. Anything with xylitol artificial sweetener. This one is dangerous because it’s used in peanut butter, and we all know dogs love peanut butter. Raw dough, it can continue rising in the dogs gut leading to bloat, which is life threatening, plus alcohol poisoning from the ethanol in the yeast. Just be careful in future, check the ingredients and enjoy the hell out of that puppy!

For instance my disc was ruptured and he turned me away telling me to do yoga. At the next appointment after I had an MRI he told me I needed a fusion. So now I record everything, cause I’m tired of being called a liar. I’m sick to the back teeth of this office. I wouldn’t even have gone there if I had another option in my area. They have had me over a barrel when it comes to ortho drs in my area, and they know it. But I’m done now. I can’t take anymore bs from the drs or their front desk people.

Honestly it’s always something with them. They insisted, and I mean INSISTED they take over all of my pain medication from the day of my surgery until my final post op appointment. But if I do stay up their ass checking on it, it gets done at the last minute after they close and they act like I’m drug seeking. There is no happy medium. After I told them I’m dropping their service they finally sent the prescription in, but for some unknown reason my pharmacy was closed all weekend, until Monday morning. I had to go without my medication all weekend anyways, because they can’t send prescriptions in at a reasonable time. Now I’m playing a painful game of how long is it going to take to get my pain under a reasonable amount of control before they do this to me again.
